feedback: Two issues require revision. (1) The 60-day notice window in Section 1 is not supported by its citation; the referenced exam manual chunk only defines what counts as an error, and the 1005.11(b) text defining the consumer notice period is not among the supplied evidence. Either remove the 60-day claim or cite supporting evidence. (2) In Section 3, the written-confirmation exception is cited to 1005.11_chunk_0002, but that provision appears in exam_manual_v2_2012_page_0701_chunk_0001; correct the citation. All other sections are supported by the supplied evidence.

All regulatory statements are properly cited and consistent with the supplied evidence. The tiered liability framework matches 1005.6 and the exam manual chart. The draft appropriately flags that the Tier 3 evidence is truncated rather than inventing a liability amount. No numeric claims conflict with supplied data (DATA is empty and no figures are fabricated). No admission of liability, no allegations presented as fact, and no unsupported promises. Citations correctly support their associated claims: the Tier 3 'may impose less' point maps to page 0698's reference to 1005.6(b)(6); the 'solely by promptness' point maps to page 0697; and the deposit-agreement restriction maps to the checklist page 0727.

The draft appropriately notes the truncation of 1005.7(b) evidence rather than fabricating additional items. No numeric claims are present (DATA is empty), no liability is admitted, and no allegations are presented as fact. No genuine issues found.

The dispute-notice contents in Section 4 overreach the supplied evidence. The cited chunk [12CFR1022_1022.43_chunk_0002] is truncated after listing only the first required item (sufficient identifying information). Either remove these items or add a note that the evidence is truncated and does not establish them, consistent with the cautious treatment applied elsewhere in the draft.
